messages:
incident-bot: [AUTOPAGER] Pager triggered for node=gpu-node-19 (rack-r3). Alert: kubelet heartbeat missing for 90s. Severity: P1. PagerDuty: PD-9012.
Aisha (oncall): acked. i'm grabbing serial/IPMI now. assigning initial triage.
Pranav: ack. standing by for console. any customer-facing service alerts?
Maya: CLS alert spike on /inference/streaming in us-west-2 for a subset of requests that touched that rack ~1m ago. Looks like transient 503s.
Aisha (oncall): noted customer impact - escalation to ops/eng if we can't restore within 10m.
Tom S.: attaching serial; incoming logs show kernel oops: "unable to handle kernel NULL pointer deref" immediately before freeze.
Aisha (oncall): thanks Tom. can you confirm kubelet status via ipmi?
Tom S.: serial dump: 
```
[ 1234.567890] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
[ 1234.567892] CPU: 3 PID: 2045 Comm: kubelet Not tainted
[ 1234.567895] Call Trace:
  dump_stack+0x45/0x60
  panic+0x101/0x2a0
  ? some_driver_fault+0x8/0x20
```

Pranav: looks like host-level kernel panic. i'll open an RMA ticket for the gpu host if we need hardware replacement.
SRE-Lead: before RMA, try soft-recovery: ipmi power-cycle then reattach to console. Also check node eviction and customer routing.
Aisha (oncall): starting evacuation plan: cordon + drain workloads on that node. Maya, can you confirm which services are on gpu-node-19?
Maya: redispatch shows 4 pods for inference-service:v3 constrained to node-19 via nodeSelector. fallback group on node-21/22 should pick up but capacity is low.
Aisha (oncall): running: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-19 && kubectl drain gpu-node-19 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30`
Pranav: while drain is running, i can spin up ephemeral burst instances if autoscaling doesn't trigger. I'll start a burst job to bring up 2 x g4dn-equivalent for immediate capacity.
Tom S.: drain logs show two pods stuck Terminating waiting on preStop hook. posting logs:
```
Pod inference-xyz Terminating - preStop: waiting on model unload (timeout 120s)
```

Maya: increasing killGrace to force eviction? we risk model state loss but we have SLA threshold.
SRE-Lead: if preStop is hung, use `kubectl delete pod <pod> --grace-period=0 --force` for those two, then let scheduler reschedule to fallback nodes. Confirming with product: acceptable for now.
Aisha (oncall): performed forced delete on the two pods. drain completed. Node marked NotReady in k8s.
incident-bot: [UPDATE] PD-9012 auto-escalation suppressed; manual ack by Aisha. Log link: https://logs.internal/PD-9012/gpu-node-19
Pranav: burst VMs started, autoscaler picked up 1/2; I'm hooking up model weights to those new instances.
Maya: traffic is rerouting. CLS error rate on that path down to baseline in last 90s.
Aisha (oncall): customer impact mitigated for now; still investigating root cause. moving to next: check NVMe and GPU driver telemetry from host. Tom, any NVMe errors in serial dump?
Tom S.: NVMe controller reports a couple of I/O timeouts prior to panic: `nvme0: I/O 0001 timeout`. Also i915/pmu messages noisy but primary trace points to a vendor kernel module referencing GPU firmware.
Pranav: which kernel version? if it's the known 5.15-rc regression we saw, we should pin until vendor patch.
Tom S.: host kernel: 5.15.12-redwood. we have a repro in staging for that kernel+driver combo.
SRE-Lead: plan: keep node cordoned, mark for RMA if soft-reboot doesn't stabilize. schedule rolling rebuild for similar nodes in rack-r3 that are running that kernel.
Aisha (oncall): creating incident ticket in ops board and notifying customer-success for impacted tenants. `INC-4981`.
Maya: can we add a temporary routing rule to avoid rack-r3 for new inference allocations until further notice?
Pranav: adding a cluster affinity policy to prefer rack-r1/r2. applying `nodeAffinity` patch to the cluster-provisioner.
Aisha (oncall): update status page draft: "Investigating a GPU host failure in us-west-2 causing transient 503s for a small percentage of streaming requests. Traffic has been rerouted; mitigation in progress." @support-team please hold off direct outreach until we confirm tenant lists.
Tom S.: attempted soft power-cycle via IPMI; host failed to come up cleanly — kernel oops on boot within ~30s.
Pranav: RMA initiated with vendor. ETA for tech on site 4-6 hours. tagging host for hardware replacement.
SRE-Lead: action items: (1) Keep node cordoned, (2) mark similar hosts for kernel downgrade/rollback in batch, (3) increase autoscaler headroom while we rebuild, (4) follow up with product for any customer-facing rollback.
Aisha (oncall): handing off to night oncall @Pranav for follow-up. I will update incident doc with steps taken. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Pranav: taking handoff — will monitor overnight and coordinate RMA. updating PD and incident doc.
incident-bot: [CLOSE NOTE] Thread acknowledged and transitioned to oncall Pranav. PD-9012 remains open until host replacement.
